items.title: Class of 2026: A Graduation Day in Brooklyn
items.description:
Twenty-five preschoolers crossed the stage at St. Francis College as the Helen Keller Services Children's Learning Center celebrated its Class of 2026. The specialized preschool program, nearly four decades in Brooklyn, expands to Long Island beginning in 2026.

The post Class of 2026: A Graduation Day in Brooklyn appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: HKNC’s Summer Youth Vocational Program Featured on the Cover of the Long Beach Herald
items.description:
The Summer Youth Vocational Program's adaptive surfing week is the cover story of this week's Long Beach Herald. The article by Chris Colucci follows six participants who spent a week surfing with Surf For All, Skudin Surf's adaptive surfing initiative in Long Beach.

The post HKNC’s Summer Youth Vocational Program Featured on the Cover of the Long Beach Herald appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: CSUN 2026 from a DeafBlind User’s Perspective: Braille Takes Center Stage
items.description:
HKNC Lead Research and Training Specialist Scott Davert spent 2.5 days on the CSUN 2026 exhibit floor. In Part 2 of his coverage, he focuses on braille technology, with new displays and notetakers from five companies, including multi-line devices that put text and tactile graphics on the same surface.

The post CSUN 2026 from a DeafBlind User’s Perspective: Braille Takes Center Stage appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: DeafBlind Awareness Week 2026: A Nationwide Celebration of Connection
items.description:
DeafBlind Awareness Week 2026 brought together partners, proclamations, and communities across the country under the theme "Connected by Touch: Breaking Barriers, Building Bridges." Here's how the week unfolded.

The post DeafBlind Awareness Week 2026: A Nationwide Celebration of Connection appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: Breaking Ground in Islandia: The Children’s Learning Center Is Coming to Long Island
items.description:
On June 18, we broke ground in Islandia on the first of two new Helen Keller Services Children's Learning Center locations coming to Long Island.

The post Breaking Ground in Islandia: The Children’s Learning Center Is Coming to Long Island appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: Governors of Kansas, North Carolina, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania Sign Proclamations Recognizing DeafBlind Awareness Week
items.description:
Governors in four states have signed proclamations recognizing DeafBlind individuals and their contributions, with Kansas, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania naming this year's theme directly - evidence that a national observance is taking root at the state level.

The post Governors of Kansas, North Carolina, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania Sign Proclamations Recognizing DeafBlind Awareness Week appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: Helen Keller National Center Launches 2026 DeafBlind Awareness Week Campaign Alongside National Coalition of Partner Organizations
items.description:
The Helen Keller National Center has launched the 2026 DeafBlind Awareness Week campaign, "Connected by Touch: Breaking Barriers, Building Bridges," highlighting how touch enables communication, connection, and access for the DeafBlind community. Six national partner organizations have joined HKNC in a joint proclamation recognizing the week.

The post Helen Keller National Center Launches 2026 DeafBlind Awareness Week Campaign Alongside National Coalition of Partner Organizations appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: CSUN 2026 from a DeafBlind User’s Perspective: Exploring New and Revisiting Paths to Access (Part 1)
items.description:
HKNC Lead Research and Training Specialist Scott Davert spent 2.5 days on the CSUN 2026 exhibit floor. In Part 1 of his coverage, he examines new products designed to expand access through touch and technology, and checks in with vendors he featured last year to see what's changed.

The post CSUN 2026 from a DeafBlind User’s Perspective: Exploring New and Revisiting Paths to Access (Part 1) appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: The Right Fit: Ben’s Pathway to Employment
items.description:
Ben came to HKNC from Utah with hands-on work experience and a clear sense of his strengths, but uncertainty about where he fit long-term. His path to employment started with exploration and ended with the right match.

The post The Right Fit: Ben’s Pathway to Employment appeared first on Helen Keller Services.

items.title: Connected by Touch: Announcing the 2026 DeafBlind Awareness Week Campaign
items.description:
Helen Keller National Center announces the 2026 DeafBlind Awareness Week campaign theme: Connected by Touch: Breaking Barriers, Building Bridges. Download proclamation templates now, and explore what's coming this spring — including the national awareness poster, professional fact sheets, webinars, and more.

The post Connected by Touch: Announcing the 2026 DeafBlind Awareness Week Campaign appeared first on Helen Keller Services.
